up: List all compounds associated with the document having ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL3638540' (from the docs table). Only include compounds that have a canonical SMILES present in the compound_structures table. For each qualifying compound, provide its ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), its preferred name (from molecule_dictionary.pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles). Return one row per compound.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id,
  md.pref_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3638540'
  AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL;
